label: Full-shift depth three
title: Twenty of the twenty-four deep rules have full-shift depth at least four; the full-shift depth ladder is separated from the ring ladder at every level
kind: Exact full-shift certificate of refinement depth at most three under four observations, with the full-shift versus rings-3-to-14 depth ladder
summary: Full-shift depth at most three is decided for every rule under 232, 200, 22 and 4 by reachability in a 65,536-vertex pair graph per rule. All three bets held: of the 24 rules with depth at most one on every ring but at least three on the full shift, 20 have full-shift depth at least four; the rings-3-to-14 depth-three gap is nonempty under each observation; and the class of full-shift depth exactly three is nonempty under each. Every rule's full-shift depth class is tabulated against its ring class.
takeaway: Closure is the only level at which periodic configurations and the full shift agree; at every depth level some rules sit strictly higher on the line, and the discrepancy widens rather than closes.
